chapter: Chicago, Ohio and Jelly Roll Morton
title: Jelly inspires him to write; college dates in Pennsylvania
summary: Watching Jelly write music pushes him to try arranging, and a Pennsylvania booker gets Jelly's band into ballrooms and colleges.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: And by me playing with Jelly, you know... Because Jelly inspired me to write. I saw him writing, and I said, 'Well, hey, I can do that.' Because I'd already started in transposition, then I got that Skinner(?) book, then I tried my hand at writing -- because I knew notation.

But I met up with Jelly again in Pennsylvania. And he got over to a guy in York, Pennsylvania, that knew all of the ballrooms in Pennsylvania. That man was something. And he booked Jelly all... See, Jelly had these records, and he played colleges and everything else. That's where I first got my college experience, playing with him. He taught us how to act at the colleges, hit with the guys, let them entertain us...
